_doc: Kolkata OSM layers for scripts/fetch-osm-layers.ts. The bbox is KMC plus the verified out-of-KMC units (EKW east, Palta about 22 km north, Budge Budge south), matching src/lib/cities/kolkata.ts.

water-bodies._note: basin stays in the allowlist: the East Kolkata Wetlands' sewage-fed bheris map as basins.

rivers._note: Wider box: the Hooghly from above Palta to the estuary. KNOWN GAP, deliberate: the Saraswati renders in two pieces with a 10.6 km break (22.6750N-22.7644N) because OSM maps that reach as 'Kana' (the dead river) and 'Khal'; matching those would sweep in every khal in the delta and assert an identity OSM does not make. Revisit only with a source that establishes the Kana reach is the Saraswati.

localities._note: No ward join: Kolkata's ward geometry is 141 of 144 with no names, so a join would silently drop localities in the missing wards.
